3490-4050-6996-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6996-8319.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

751-1322-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4549-7918.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-7918.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

364-1170-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

261-1339-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
261-1339-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

628-728-7216.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

2438-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4559-5147-6753-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-5147-6753-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4270-6628-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
4270-6628-7857.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping PuPu UFO
Repeat.

1308-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1497-3327-4613-7804.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
The top card of your library is a nonland card.
1497-3327-4613-7804.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

3652-3661-5863-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3652-3661-5863-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

338-549-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-549-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1753-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-1753-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1753-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

4331-4993-5116-7692.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Clever Impersonator that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Clever Impersonator token instead.
2523-2869-4753.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

1739-2034-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Herald's Horn.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

814-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
814-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2366-5702-7175-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5702-7175-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

5526-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5526-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

372-2292-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-4053-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-4053-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1778-2173-5220-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

1029-1336-5028.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Heronblade Elite.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1336-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

488-641-1482-2478-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1482-2478-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

465-643-1115-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1115-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1115-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2730-4871-5006-5147.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2730-4871-5006-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

168-526-3129-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-3129-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

4659-5365-5491-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5491-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and a Map artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Map or Clue, adding {C}{C}.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

575-4050-4864.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Monastery Flock, adding {U}.
When Monastery Flock dies, Yedora triggers, returning Monastery Flock from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Monastery Flock by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Monastery Flock's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

719-751-2972.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Shireking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1750-4084-4861-5261.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Part the Waterveil.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Part the Waterveil into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Part the Waterveil from your graveyard by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Part the Waterveil.
Repeat from step 2.
